narrative_vs_numbers.point: Management claimed 46% YoY Q3 revenue growth; reported Dec 2025 revenue grew 46.1% YoY to ₹7636.0 crore.
Management claimed FY26 revenue crossed ₹285 billion; reported Mar 2026 full-year revenue reached ₹28,884.0 crore.
Management claimed Q2 FY27 revenue grew 53% YoY; reported Sep 2026 revenue rose 52.8% to ₹9899.0 crore.
Management claimed Q4 FY26 PAT grew 7% YoY; reported Mar 2026 PAT reached ₹786.0 crore, up 7.1% YoY.

bull: Revenue growth accelerated to 52.8% YoY in Sep 2026 (₹9899.0 crore), reaching record quarterly top-line.
Balance sheet remains virtually debt-free with D/E of 0.02 and 5-year operating cash conversion of 101% of PAT.
Working capital cycle reduced to approximately 11 days in Q2 FY27 from 65 days two years prior.
bear: Quarterly EBITDA margin dipped from 16.0% in Sep 2025 to 13.0% in Dec 2025 and Mar 2026.
Management walked back EPC margin guidance from high single digits (g1.3) to mid-to-high single digits (g2.5).
Long-term Project Spring goals (>10% exports, 8-10% FMEG EBITDA margin) remain unverified due to lack of quarterly segment disclosures.
watch: Sustaining company EBITDA margin at or above 14.0% in coming quarters.
Execution of ₹12 billion to ₹16 billion annual capex program and FY28 EHV commissioning.
Sustainability of reduced 11-day working capital cycle.
